attachment: A marker at an atom beginning after stripping at most one bullet attaches the complete atom to the previous same-paragraph group, transitively. No attachment crosses blank-line paragraph boundaries.
hypothesis_claim: Proposed mitigation of observed clause omission, not a proven causal fix. Retained-but-misclassified restrictions may remain wrong.
literal_sentence_boundary_limitation: Exact inherited regex atoms include semicolon boundaries and may split abbreviations; this is not a linguistic sentence parser. Decimal punctuation followed by a digit is not a boundary. All source characters including whitespace/tails remain partitioned.

packing.coverage: Whole selected/omitted unit/group spans, all original numeric spans and retained booleans, raw candidate token counts and full group admission attempts. Retention/omission are mechanical, never sufficiency annotations or a typed decision rule.
packing.final_text: Merge adjacent selected source-unit spans, retain global source order, join disjoint spans by two newlines. No rewritten aliases, predicates, numbers, selected evidence or hypotheses.
packing.optional_neighbor_stage: Only after all ranked groups. For each newly admitted ranked group in admission order, try previous then next same-paragraph group only if not among ranked groups, not already preselected/admitted and not already inspected. Each optional whole group considered once.
packing.ranked_stage: Deduplicate group IDs in order of first member among exact observed first min40 unit IDs. Scan each whole group once. Admit all its units together iff exact joint source-order premise plus whole claim fits512. Over-budget group is entirely omitted.
packing.shared_definition_priority: Original15 marker regex and160-token cap, but complete source groups only; groups containing token fallback fragments cannot become shared definitions. Claim-independent global source order; whole prelude must fit jointly with whole claim.

partition.limit_failure: Reject complete source before a forward if unit cap or indivisible token capacity fails; no clipping or adaptive second policy.
partition.oversized_atom: Exact prior6 token-offset partition fallback. Every fragment of an original atom shares one group and is admitted atomically with its attached qualifiers, never a partial group.

removed_counterfactual: Old no-priority tokenization-only counterfactual removed; no extra model/control arm added.
retrieval: Actual384D BGE vector per complete bounded unit, using unchanged query prefix. Native top40 unit order stays literal. Lexical same Jaccard/source tie and positional first40 unit controls unchanged. Group priority is first observed group-member in each selector unit order; no invented group scores or extra retrieval.
scope: One preselected source-only evidence packing method shared identically by native/lexical/positional arms. No labels, corpus text, tokenizer parser or inference used to choose this contract.
